title: Towards AI Transparency and Accountability: A Global Framework for Exchanging Information on AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Proposes standardizing statistical fairness measures (e.g., demographic disparity) and explainable AI input influence measures (using methods like SHAP or LIME) to identify direct discrimination and indirect proxy discrimination (e.g., using zip codes).

Proposes evaluating demographic disparity and input influence measures to detect disparate impact and prevent 'fairness gerrymandering' (where fairness for one group causes unfairness for another) in high-stakes areas like automated hiring.
